idea-plugin.name: JDK 25 Upgrade Blocker Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the Java lines the new LTS removed — 18 rules; 23 findings in one 64-line fixture

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → JDK 25 Upgrade Blocker Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 18 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/jdk25-upgrade-blocker-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/jdk25-upgrade-blocker-lint
